issue.title: Snooze feature broke two unit tests: relation-links-stage order and prose-field-roles modal lint
issue.description:
## CI failure

Two deterministic unit failures from the recently landed Alt+Z Snooze Card feature (ad38b38a), untouched by the embedded-catalog-cards change.

1. `scripts/test-navigation-relation-links-stage.cjs` — "links-to row follows blocks with N, first label, cut target, and +K": expects link-row order `['schedule', 'depends-on', 'blocks', 'links-to', ...]` but the code now emits `'snooze'` second. The test was last touched before the snooze feature landed.
2. `scripts/test-prose-field-roles.cjs` — asserts `plugins/bob-navigation-hotkeys/src/744-snooze-card-modal.js` text control has a `bob-text` role within the previous 3 lines; the new modal does not satisfy the prose roles lint.

Remediation: update both tests (and/or the modal) for the snooze row and modal roles. Verify with `node --test scripts/test-navigation-relation-links-stage.cjs` and `node scripts/test-prose-field-roles.cjs`.

task_type_fields.why_not_flake: Embedded catalog cards implementation, workspace bob-cli_15. Both failures reproduce deterministically in isolation on the final tree (post-merge c41e07e9): the relation-links assertion diff is a static expectation mismatch (expected list lacks 'snooze'), and the prose lint is a static source-roles check on 744-snooze-card-modal.js. Neither file is touched by the embedded-catalog-cards change (git diff shows no overlap), and both failures name the recently landed Alt+Z Snooze Card feature (ad38b38a). Deterministic, not load-related.

issue.creation_reason: Pre-existing deterministic unit failures from the landed Snooze Card feature; they fail full npm test on master and are unrelated to the embedded-catalog-cards change.

payload.entry: Caused by epic bob-cli-q5.6.1 (Snooze Card) and fixed in its landing commit in bob-plugins: test-navigation-relation-links-stage.cjs now expects the planned 'snooze' row after 'schedule'; 744-snooze-card-modal.js declares '// bob-text: literal snooze time' above the time input. The landing also fixed a third epic-caused failure (test-navigation-task-card-view.cjs 'q closes from a focused More row' asserted z was inert; z is now the Snooze row) and added a Task Card z dispatch/repeat-guard unit test. Verified: node --test on both nodes plus task-card view/model and snooze-card suites, 241/241 pass on bob-plugins c6fbeb36 + landing edits.

payload.close_reason: Epic-caused defect fixed by the bob-cli-q5.6.1 land agent
